subject: the trading mistake that keeps you broke
title: The Trading Mistake That Keeps You Broke
hook: You're not losing money because of bad strategy.
script: You're not losing money because of bad strategy. You're losing because you can't sit still. The average trader checks their position dozens of times a day, and every check is a chance to panic sell a winner or double down on a loser. Professionals do the opposite. They set the trade, set the stop, and walk away. Boredom is the price of consistency. If watching your portfolio feels exciting, you're probably gambling, not trading. Close the app and let the plan work.
